_comment: Confirmation prompts shown before a button sends. These are the only strings in the database that speak to the operator, and half of them precede something irreversible on a live vehicle — so they say what will happen rather than just shouting Attention. Note 'Adomètre' is a typo for 'Odomètre' in the source; translated by intent.
Attention, effacement des pannes mémoris: This clears the stored fault codes.
This clears the stored fault codes.
Attention, effacement de la Freeze Frame: This clears the OBD freeze frame.
Avez-vous configuré les quatre valeurs: Have you set all four values?
